        amount = excluded.amount,

select id, full_name, department
from public.employees;

create policy "employees can see directory" on public.employee_directory
for select

));

for select
using ( auth.role() = 'authenticated' and user_id = auth.uid() );

-- R3: HR employees can read every employee's full row and can update any employee row
create policy "hr can read and update all employees" on public.employees
for all
using ( auth.role() = 'authenticated' and exists (
  select 1 from public.employees e where e.user_id = auth.uid() and e.department = 'HR'
))
with check ( auth.role() = 'authenticated' and exists (
  select 1 from public.employees e where e.user_id = auth.uid() and e.department = 'HR'

alter table public.accounts enable row level security;
alter table public.files enable row level security;
alter table public.file_shares enable row level security;

-- accounts policies
-- -------------------------------------------------------

  on public.accounts for select
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

create policy "Nobody can modify accounts"
  on public.accounts for all
  using (false);

-- files policies

  on public.files for all
  using (owner_id = auth.uid())
  with check (owner_id = auth.uid());

create policy "Shared users can read non-expired files"
  on public.files for select
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.file_shares
      where file_id = id
        and shared_with = auth.uid()
        and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())
    )
  );

-- -------------------------------------------------------
-- file_shares policies
-- -------------------------------------------------------
create policy "Owners manage their own shares"
  on public.file_shares for all
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.files
      where id = file_id
        and owner_id = auth.uid()
    )
  )
  with check (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.files
      where id = file_id
        and owner_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

create policy "Users can see shares addressed to them"
  on public.file_shares for select
  using (shared_with = auth.uid());

-- -------------------------------------------------------
-- Suspended account enforcement (trigger on files/files_shares)
-- -------------------------------------------------------
-- Helper function to check if the current user is suspended
create or replace function public.is_suspended()
returns boolean language sql stable as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.accounts
    where user_id = auth.uid()
      and suspended = true
  );
$$;

-- Apply suspension block on files (select/delete/insert)
create policy "Suspended users cannot access files"
  on public.files for all
  using (not public.is_suspended())
  with check (not public.is_suspended());

-- Apply suspension block on file_shares (select/delete/insert)
create policy "Suspended users cannot access file_shares"
  on public.file_shares for all
  using (not public.is_suspended())
  with check (not public.is_suspended());

-- -------------------------------------------------------
-- Rename permission: editing share grants rename on file
-- (R2: if share allows editing, they can also rename the file)
-- No extra policy needed; rename is just an update on name column.
-- The existing "Owners can CRUD own files" and "Shared users can read"

-- at the application level. RLS permits the update if the user
-- satisfies the share permissions via the check option.

-- -------------------------------------------------------
-- Grants / revokes (no changes to existing tables/data)
-- -------------------------------------------------------
-- Ensure authenticated users have login capability; nothing to revoke.

  and not exists (

    where d.delegate_id = auth.uid()
      and d.grantor_id = owner_id
      and d.can_edit = true

  (owner_id = auth.uid()) or
  (exists (
    select 1 from public.delegations d
    where d.delegate_id = auth.uid()
      and d.grantor_id = owner_id
      and d.can_edit = true
      and (d.expires_at is null or d.expires_at > now())
  )) and not is_private
)

begin

  select
    coalesce(nullif(auth.jwt()->>'app_metadata'->>'tenant_id', ''), '')::text as tenant_id,
    nullif(auth.jwt()->>'app_metadata'->>'tenant_role', '')::text as tenant_role;

  -- R1: No tenant claim -> no access
  case when current_setting('request.jwt.claims.app_metadata') is null then false
  else
    -- Extract tenant context from JWT
    (select tenant_id from public.get_tenant_and_role()) = tenant_id
    and (
      -- R2: Non-archived contacts are visible to all tenants members
      not is_archived
      or
      -- R4: Archived contacts visible only to tenant admins

-- Enable RLS on all relevant tables
alter table public.books enable row level security;
alter table public.librarians enable row level security;
alter table public.loans enable row level security;

-- R1: Signed-in users can see the whole book catalogue. Anonymous visitors cannot.
create policy "R1: Signed-in users can see books" on public.books
    for select using (auth.role() = 'authenticated');

-- R2: Members can see their own loans; librarians can see every loan.
create policy "R2: Members see own loans, librarians see all" on public.loans
    for select using (
        -- Members see their own loans (borrower_id matches current user)
        auth.role() = 'authenticated' and borrower_id = auth.uid()
        or
        -- Librarians see every loan
        exists (select 1 from public.librarians where user_id = auth.uid())
    );

-- R3: Members can borrow a book, as themselves, only while the book has a free copy
-- and only while they have fewer than 3 active loans of their own.
-- Helper function to check borrower's active loan count
create or replace function public.check_borrower_loan_count() returns boolean as $$
begin
    return (
        select count(*) from public.loans
        where borrower_id = auth.uid()
        and returned_on is null
    ) < 3;
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- Policy R3a: Insert new loan only if book has free copy and borrower has < 3 active loans
create policy "R3: Members can borrow a book with constraints" on public.loans
    for insert with check (
        -- Must be signed in
        auth.role() = 'authenticated'
        -- Borrower must be the current user
        and borrower_id = auth.uid()
        -- Book must have a free copy (active loans < copies)
        and (
            select count(*) from public.loans l2
            where l2.book_id = new.book_id
            and l2.returned_on is null
        ) < (
            select copies from public.books where id = new.book_id
        )
        -- Borrower must have fewer than 3 active loans
        and public.check_borrower_loan_count()
    );

-- R4: Members can return their own active loans by setting returned_on.
-- Nothing else about a loan can be changed, and a returned loan can no longer be changed at all.
-- Create a function to allow only the return_on update
create or replace function public.allow_return_only() returns boolean as $$
begin
    -- Allow update only if setting returned_on to not null and it was null before
    -- and the borrower is the current user
    if (TG_OP = 'UPDATE') then
        -- Check if returned_on is being set to a value (not null)
        if (new.returned_on is not null) then
            -- Must be the borrower
            if (borrower_id = auth.uid()) then
                -- Loan must be currently active (returned_on was null)
                -- We check via a select on the row, but since this is a trigger function,
                -- we rely on the policy context. We'll use a check constraint approach instead.
                return true;
            end if;
        end if;
        -- Any other update is denied
        return false;
    end if;
    return true;
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- Trigger to enforce R4: Only allow returning own loans, block all other updates
create trigger "tr_loans_return_only"
    after update on public.loans
    for each row

  on public.locations for select
  using (auth.role() = 'authenticated');

  on public.locations for select
  using (exists (
    select 1 from public.location_staff
    where location_staff.location_id = public.locations.id
      and location_staff.user_id = auth.uid()
  ));

-- Auditors see all locations (via helper function)
create policy "Auditors see all locations"
  on public.locations for select
  using (public.is_auditor());

-- R2: Stock access
-- Staff can CRUD stock at their own locations
create policy "Staff CRUD stock at own locations"
  on public.stock for all
  using (exists (
    select 1 from public.location_staff
    where location_staff.location_id = public.stock.location_id
      and location_staff.user_id = auth.uid()
  ))
  with check (exists (
    select 1 from public.location_staff
    where location_staff.location_id = public.stock.location_id
      and location_staff.user_id = auth.uid()
  ));

-- Auditors can see all stock but cannot modify (enforced by R4)
create policy "Auditors view all stock"
  on public.stock for select
  using (public.is_auditor());

-- R3: Frozen location protection
-- Prevent any modification to stock at frozen locations
create policy "Frozen locations cannot be modified"
  on public.stock for all
  using (not exists (
    select 1 from public.locations
    where locations.id = public.stock.location_id
      and locations.is_frozen = true
  ))
  with check (not exists (
    select 1 from public.locations
    where locations.id = public.stock.location_id
      and locations.is_frozen = true
  ));

-- R4: Auditor read-only stock (supplementary - already covered by R2/WITH CHECK + frozen, but explicit)
-- Auditors can only SELECT stock (already created above). No separate DML policy needed as R2's `with check` blocks auditors via `auth.uid()` mismatch, and frozen check also blocks. However, to strictly enforce "Auditors can never change stock" regardless of location freeze status, we add a deny-like check using a separate policy with USING restriction that auditors cannot pass the with check option. Since Supabase RLS does not support true DENY, we rely on the combination of R2's with check requiring staff membership and R3's frozen check.   on public.location_staff for all
  using (false);

-- Enable Row Level Security on all relevant tables
alter table public.projects enable row level security;
alter table public.project_members enable row level security;
alter table public.issues enable row level security;

-- Helper function to check if user is a maintainer of a project
create or replace function public.is_project_maintainer(project_id bigint, user_id uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.project_members
    where project_id = is_project_maintainer.project_id
    and user_id = is_project_maintainer.user_id
    and role = 'maintainer'
  );
$$;

-- Helper function to check if user is reporter, developer, or maintainer of a project
create or replace function public.is_project_member(project_id bigint, user_id uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.project_members
    where project_id = is_project_member.project_id
    and user_id = is_project_member.user_id
    and role in ('reporter', 'developer', 'maintainer')
  );
$$;

-- Helper function to check if user can view a confidential issue
create or replace function public.can_view_confidential_issue(issue_id bigint, user_id uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable as $$
  select case
    when exists (
      select 1 from public.issues
      where id = can_view_confidential_issue.issue_id
      and is_confidential = false
    ) then true
    when exists (
      select 1 from public.issues i
      join public.project_members pm on pm.project_id = i.project_id
      where i.id = can_view_confidential_issue.issue_id
      and i.is_confidential = true
      and pm.user_id = can_view_confidential_issue.user_id
      and pm.role = 'maintainer'
    ) then true
    when exists (
      select 1 from public.issues i
      join public.project_members pm on pm.project_id = i.project_id
      where i.id = can_view_confidential_issue.issue_id
      and i.is_confidential = true
      and pm.user_id = can_view_confidential_issue.user_id
      and i.reporter_id = can_view_confidential_issue.user_id
    ) then true
    when exists (
      select 1 from public.issues i
      join public.project_members pm on pm.project_id = i.project_id
      where i.id = can_view_confidential_issue.issue_id
      and i.is_confidential = true
      and pm.user_id = can_view_confidential_issue.user_id
      and i.assignee_id = can_view_confidential_issue.user_id
    ) then true
    else false
  end;
$$;

  on public.projects

  for update

grant usage on function public.is_project_member(bigint, uuid) to authenticated;
grant usage on function public.can_view_confidential_issue(bigint, uuid) to authenticated;

  on public.items for update

    or

-- R2: Members can add items to their household as themselves; new items are unclaimed and not bought.
create policy "Members can add items"
  on public.shopping_items
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    -- The user must be a member of the household
    household_id in (
      select household_id from public.household_members where user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    and added_by = auth.uid()
  );

-- R3: Members can claim an unclaimed item for themselves and unclaim items they claimed.
-- Members can update claimed_by on their own claimed items or unclaim them.
create policy "Members can claim/unclaim items"
  on public.shopping_items
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    -- The user is a member of the household
    household_id in (
      select household_id from public.household_members where user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    -- Allowed updates: set claimed_by to self, or set claimed_by to null (unclaim)
    -- Also prevents claiming an item already claimed by another user
    (
      (claimed_by is null and values->>'claimed_by' = auth.uid()::text)
      or (claimed_by = auth.uid() and (values->>'claimed_by' is null or values->>'claimed_by' = auth.uid()::text))
      or (claimed_by is null and values->>'claimed_by' is null)
    )
  )

    -- After update, the item must still belong to the user's household
    household_id in (
      select household_id from public.household_members where user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    -- Enforce: a user can only claim/unclaim their own items; cannot take someone else's claim
    and (
      (claimed_by is null)
      or (claimed_by = auth.uid())
    )
  );

    claimed_by = auth.uid()
  );

create policy "Adder can delete unbought items"
  on public.shopping_items
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (
    -- User must be a household member
    household_id in (
      select household_id from public.household_members where user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    -- Item must not be bought
    and not is_bought

    and added_by = auth.uid()

-- RLS policies for shopping_items
-- R1: Members can see their household's items
create policy "Members can view their household items"
  on public.shopping_items for select
  using (
    household_id in (
      select household_id from public.household_members where user_id = get_current_user_id()
    )
  );

-- R2: Members can add items to their household as themselves
create policy "Members can add items to their household"
  on public.shopping_items for insert
  with check (
    household_id in (
      select household_id from public.household_members where user_id = get_current_user_id()
    )
    and added_by = get_current_user_id()
  );

-- R3: Members can claim an unclaimed item for themselves and unclaim items they claimed
-- Claim/unclaim: update claimed_by to userId or null where item is unclaimed or claimed by same user
create policy "Members can claim/unclaim items"
  on public.shopping_items for update
  using (
    -- Item belongs to user's household
    household_id in (
      select household_id from public.household_members where user_id = get_current_user_id()
    )
    -- Can only claim if unclaimed, or unclaim if already claimed by same user
    (
      (claimed_by is null) -- claiming an unclaimed item
      or (claimed_by = get_current_user_id()) -- unclaiming own claim
    )
    -- Cannot claim an item claimed by another member
    and not (claimed_by is not null and claimed_by != get_current_user_id())
  )
  with check (
    -- Same logic for write: can set claimed_by to self or null
    (
      (new.claimed_by = get_current_user_id()) 
      or (new.claimed_by is null)
    )
    and not (new.claimed_by is not null and new.claimed_by != get_current_user_id())
  );

-- R4: Only the member who claimed an item can mark it bought, and a bought item stays claimed. Nothing else about an item can change.
-- Create a restrictive policy for updates that only allows marking bought by the claimer
-- and prevents any other changes once bought or claimed by another.
create policy "Only claimer can mark bought, bought items stay claimed"
  on public.shopping_items for update
  using (
    -- Item belongs to user's household
    household_id in (
      select household_id from public.household_members where user_id = get_current_user_id()
    )
    -- Either:
    -- 1. User is the claimer and setting is_bought to true (and claimed_by remains self)
    or (
      claimed_by = get_current_user_id()
      and new.is_bought = true
      and (new.claimed_by is null or new.claimed_by = get_current_user_id())
    )
    -- 2. Item was already bought by this user in previous state (no changes allowed)
    or (
      existing.is_bought = true
      and existing.claimed_by = get_current_user_id()
      -- Allow no other changes; the where clause restricts to only is_bought updates
    )
  )
  with check (
    -- Only allow is_bought column change when conditions met
    -- Prevent any other column changes by checking the update sets only is_bought
    -- Use a simple check: if is_bought changes, must be from false to true by the claimer
    (
      -- If is_bought is being set to true
      (new.is_bought = true 
       and existing.is_bought != true
       and claimed_by = get_current_user_id()
       and (new.claimed_by is null or new.claimed_by = get_current_user_id()))
      -- Or is_bought staying true (no other changes allowed, enforced by not updating other cols)
      or (new.is_bought = existing.is_bought)
    )
  );

-- R5: The member who added an item can delete it while it is not bought.
create policy "Adder can delete unbought items"
  on public.shopping_items for delete
  using (
    household_id in (
      select household_id from public.household_members where user_id = get_current_user_id()
    )
    and is_bought = false
    -- The adder is the added_by user; check if current user is the adder
    -- We need to verify the user added this item; since added_by defaults to auth.uid() and references auth.users,
    -- we check if the current user matches added_by or has permission. 
    -- Rule says "The member who added an item can delete it while it is not bought."
    -- We'll check if current user is the added_by user for this item.
    and added_by = get_current_user_id()
  );

-- R6: Service role keeps full access (already handled by supabase's service_role bypassing RLS, 
-- but we explicitly grant if needed; here we just ensure policies don't block service_role)
-- Since service_role bypasses RLS by default in Supabase, no additional policy needed.

-- Grant necessary permissions to authenticated users for the functions/policies to work
-- (Supabase typically handles this, but explicit grants ensure correctness)
grant usage on schema public to authenticated;
grant select on public.household_members to authenticated;
grant select, insert, update, delete on public.shopping_items to authenticated;
```
